g.text: Theo Prisma schema tai baseline 7feda73 - khong chung minh runtime
Thuoc tinh rut gon; timestamps day du xem schema.prisma.
Cardinality theo FK/schema. Nghiep vu tao don phai kiem tra >=1 item.
Partial unique SQL: toi da 1 SUCCEEDED/order va 1 EARN/order.
OrderStatus: PENDING, PAID, PAYMENT_FAILED, PREPARING, READY, COMPLETED, CANCELLED.
Schema/constraint khong thay cho state machine, idempotency va concurrency runtime.
